items.name: Extreme Wide Shot (EWS)
items.description: The subject is barely visible. Emphasizes the location/environment.

items.name: Wide Shot (WS)
items.description: Subject fits fully in the frame. Shows body language and setting.

items.name: Medium Shot (MS)
items.description: Waist up. Good for dialogue and action.

items.name: Medium Close Up (MCU)
items.description: Chest up. Captures facial expressions while keeping some background.

items.name: Close Up (CU)
items.description: Face or specific detail fills the frame. High emotion.

items.name: Extreme Close Up (ECU)
items.description: Focuses on a tiny detail (eye, mouth, trigger). Intense focus.

items.name: Bird's Eye View
items.description: Directly overhead. Shows layout or makes subjects look insignificant.

items.name: High Angle
items.description: Camera looks down. Makes subject look weak or vulnerable.

items.name: Eye Level
items.description: Neutral angle. Mimics human vision. Connects with the character.

items.name: Low Angle
items.description: Camera looks up. Makes subject look powerful or heroic.

items.name: Worm's Eye View
items.description: From the ground looking up. Extreme height/power.

items.name: Dutch Angle
items.description: Tilted horizon. Creates uneasiness, tension, or disorientation.

items.name: Pan
items.description: Camera swivels horizontally from a fixed point.

items.name: Tilt
items.description: Camera swivels vertically from a fixed point.

items.name: Dolly In/Out
items.description: Camera physically moves towards or away from subject.

items.name: Truck
items.description: Camera physically moves sideways (parallel to action).

items.name: Pedestal
items.description: Camera physically moves up or down.

items.name: Handheld
items.description: Shaky, raw motion. Adds realism or chaos.

items.name: Steadicam/Gimbal
items.description: Smooth, floating motion following the action.
